📋 **Rounding Decision Confirmed**

The product owner has approved the checkout total rounding approach:

• **Method**: Half-to-even rounding (banker's rounding)
• **Examples**: 
  - 1.005 → 1.00
  - 1.015 → 1.02

This approach minimizes systematic bias in financial calculations. Please ensure all checkout implementations use this rounding method.

Open: Tax reconciliation report ownership—follow up separately.

**Subject**: Rounding Decision Approved – Half-to-Even Method for Checkout

---

**Body**:

Hi team,

Following the product owner review, the checkout total rounding strategy has been approved.

**Decision: Half-to-even rounding (banker's rounding)**

Examples:
- 1.005 rounds to 1.00
- 1.015 rounds to 1.02

This method distributes rounding error evenly and is preferred for financial calculations.

Please update all checkout implementations to use this approach.

**Open item**: Tax reconciliation report ownership—will be assigned separately.

Best regards,
BA Team
